Phenomenal Evil PowerDoom-boss Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the heart of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell grants Doom-boss Veigar a stack of Phenomenal Evil, giving him @Spell.Ruby_Boss_FNVeigarPassive:APPerStack@ Ability Power. Takedowns grant an additional 5 stacks.

Doom-boss Veigar's evilness has earned him a total of @f1@ Ability Power:
  • Baleful Strike: @f2@
    Dark Matter: @f3@
    Event Horizon: @f4@
    Primordial Burst: @f5@
    Takedowns: @f6@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Doom-boss Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Doom-boss Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Doom-boss Veigar's Abilities grant him @dAbilityStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional @dTakedownStacks@ stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Doom-boss Veigar @APPerStack@ Ability Power.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Doom-boss Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>@MinDamage@ and @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for @SpiritRealmDuration@s, stealing @StatStealPercentScalar*100@% of their core stats for the duration.

If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Core stats stolen include: <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <scaleAD>Attack Damage</scaleAD>, <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, and <scaleHealth>Maximum Health</scaleHealth>.</rules>
